doc_section: Change Color Scheme and Banner Message
steps:
2. Change Color Scheme and Banner Message Update
Procedure
Click the logged-in username in the upper-right corner of Oracle Fusion.
Select Setup and Maintenance.
Open the Tasks panel near the left section of the page.
Use the search field to search for Manage Administrator Profile Values.
Open the matching task.
Search for profile option FND_BANNER_MESSAGE.
Locate the Profile Values section in the middle of the page.
Click the New icon above the values table.
Set Profile Level to Site.
Enter the environment banner message in the Profile Value text field.
Click Save and Close near the upper-right area.
Expected Results
Task completes successfully without Oracle validation or save errors.
